published_ranges._ams: Official: engineered for ACE 2 Pro (sold also as 'TPU for ACE', identical to TPU 68D); no Bambu AMS statement.
published_ranges._notes: Specs from anycubic.au/products/tpu-68d; temps/bed/speed confirmed by Anycubic Official Store Amazon listing B0GXDRD2D3 ('TPU for ACE', 1.75mm). Drying marked required but no temperature/time published; Vicat, HDT and max volumetric speed fields are blank on the page (earlier snippet HDT 183C not found, not used). No glue needed; all nozzle types. Bambu parent not confirmed (Bambu TPU for AMS is also 68D).
